findings.issue: E4 says skip lands within 1e-12 of the leg; the 1e-9-of-step nudge deliberately overshoots the boundary into the next phase (~60 ns on a 60 s cruise, tens of metres at 0.999c). No test measures landing precision; only the phase sequence and the final target pos are asserted.
Sun half-rapidity approach rule has no direct test (sunPhi/sunA unused in the assertion). Mutation: 0.5 -> 0.9 or 0.1 survives; also the Sun's approach start angle (~11 deg) is not checked.

Cruise bound 45-75 s is looser than E2's 60 +/- 10 s; boost 30 s is checked tightly. A bisection or cruise-time regression of up to 15 s would pass. The headless GD test checks the cruise only via coast_s thresholds.

findings.issue: Design says phaseAt gains Approaching; the package keeps phaseAt unchanged (approach is Decelerating, flagged by inApproach). This is a reasonable, documented API-stability choice (CHANGELOG), and tripphase.ail maps it to index 4. Update the design text.
Host computes distances from sim positions and ly/km/AU constants, display only (no physics formula), acceptable under CLAUDE.md, but unit constants are duplicated in GDScript.

No replay case exercises a timed/approach plan, so VM-vs-interpreter bit identity of the new journey path relies on checkTimedLegs inside make parity, not a recorded NDJSON golden. Untimed bit-identity is covered (9 replay cases identical; phaseEnd(2)=tauTotal-0.0 is exact; index 4 only arises when tauApproach>0).
